name: Directional Textured Tracelines
aliases: Texture Map Animation for Vector Magnitude
definition: A flow visualization technique using 1D primitives (lines) to convey orientation and extent, enhanced with an animated 1D texture to indicate flow direction, which standard lines fail to show.
summary: Directional Textured Tracelines resolve flow direction ambiguity in streamlines by animating a 1D texture along the line to convey vector field motion.
